definitions.strength_reference: Formal V2 pre-match 1X2 only; strong side=max(p_home,p_away), weak side=min(p_home,p_away), strength_gap=abs(p_home-p_away). Actual result never defines the group.
definitions.upset_event: actual win by the Formal-V2-defined weak side; evaluated over all fixtures, never only realized upsets
definitions.balanced_low_goal: balanced and Formal V2 expected total goals < 2.5
definitions.balanced_open: balanced and Formal V2 expected total goals >= 2.5
definitions.uncertainty: Formal V2 1X2 entropy: low <0.90, mid [0.90,1.03), high >=1.03; max probability is reported separately and is not treated as strength equality
definitions.time_groups: season plus fixed calendar half: Aug-Dec=H1, Jan-Jul=H2
definitions.conditional_shape_audit: normalize each 15x15 matrix inside home/draw/away outcome regions and compare cell distributions; max absolute difference reported
definitions.score_topk: rank all 225 exact-score cells by probability; ties use strict-greater rank
definitions.fallback: V3.1.1 matrix exactly equals Formal V2 matrix within 1e-15
